description_full: Nexa Resources S.A., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the zinc mining and smelting business worldwide. The company operates in two segments, Mining and Smelting. It produces metallic zinc, zamac, gold, sulfuric acid and zinc oxide, as well as by-products, such as sulfuric acid, silver concentrate, copper cement, copper sulfate, lead concentrate, lead-silver concentrate, and other metallurgical by-products. The Company owns and operates three polymetallic mines in Peru and two polymetallic mines in Brazil. The company owns and operates three polymetallic mines in Peru and two polymetallic mines in Brazil; zinc smelter in Peru and two zinc smelters in Brazil. The company was formerly known as VM Holding S.A. and changed its name to Nexa Resources S.A. in September 2017. The company was founded in 1956 and is based in Luxembourg, Luxembourg. Nexa Resources S.A. is a subsidiary of Votorantim S.A.

financial_summary: Nexa Resources S.A. is a small-cap basic materials business with a $1.5B market cap on $3.0B of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at -0% over the past three years — essentially flat, and a business treading water is rarely a path to compounding.

Returns on capital run at 15% against a 12% cost of capital, which means the business barely earns its keep economically, and 21% gross margins are typical of commodity economics where competitors can replicate the product cheaply.

The business throws off $13M in free cash flow — roughly 0 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 1.64× so those profits are backed by real cash.
On the balance sheet, leverage is comfortably conservative at 1.4× net debt/EBITDA, and thin 1.6× interest coverage leaves no room for a bad year.

Shareholder yield of 2.3% reflects a genuine commitment to returning capital rather than empire-building, and insiders hold 65% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is.
